I am an old woman, 62 years, and this maize plot is not even my own land — I rent it, so I must be careful how I spend my small money. I will buy a little NPK and urea because our soil here in the South East is tired and without fertilizer the maize will not fill the cob, but I cannot afford the full recommended bag. I will use improved seed from the agro-dealer since it gives better yield, and I will put some poultry droppings I gather from the compound. My children and grandchildren will help me weed, but my back is not strong so I will hire a few young men for the ridging and harvest.
